_comment: Example allowlist for: axiom discover --allowlist approved_servers.json. A discovered server matches an entry by 'package' (npm/PyPI package or container image) or 'url' (remote servers), or by 'name' when the entry's package/url does not contradict what is configured. If 'version' is set, the configured server must pin exactly that version or it is classified 'unknown-version'. Servers matching no entry are 'unapproved' and produce one HIGH finding each (OWASP ASI04 / MCP09).
